<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>大笑奶龙</title>
<style>
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #fff3dc; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 240px; height: 240px; }

</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfff3dc);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.15;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(32, 1, 0.1, 100);
camera.position.set(0, 3.15, 10.2);
camera.lookAt(0, 2.25, 0);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffbeb, 0x9b805c, 2.1));

const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 3.0);
key.position.set(4, 7, 7);
key.castShadow = true;
key.shadow.mapSize.set(1024, 1024);
key.shadow.camera.left = -6;
key.shadow.camera.right = 6;
key.shadow.camera.top = 7;
key.shadow.camera.bottom = -3;
key.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
key.shadow.camera.far = 25;
key.shadow.bias = -0.0005;
scene.add(key);

const backLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe5a8, 1.8);
backLight.position.set(-4, 5, -6);
scene.add(backLight);

const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xd9ecff, 1.0);
fillLight.position.set(-6, 3, 4);
scene.add(fillLight);

const yellow = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf7c843, roughness: 0.72 });
const lightYellow = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffd95c, roughness: 0.7 });
const bellyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffedae, roughness: 0.82 });
const spineMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe9a52e, roughness: 0.78 });
const darkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x38231d, roughness: 0.9 });
const mouthMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x491b24, roughness: 0.88 });
const tongueMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf17883, roughness: 0.75 });
const toothMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xfffdf0, roughness: 0.55 });
const cheekMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf2a63c, roughness: 0.85 });

const sphereGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 40, 28);

function ellipsoid(parent, name, position, scale, material) {
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, material);
  mesh.name = name;
  mesh.position.set(...position);
  mesh.scale.set(...scale);
  mesh.castShadow = true;
  mesh.receiveShadow = true;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function capsuleBetween(parent, name, a, b, radius, material) {
  const start = new THREE.Vector3(...a);
  const end = new THREE.Vector3(...b);
  const delta = end.clone().sub(start);
  const length = Math.max(0.01, delta.length() - radius * 2);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(radius, length, 8, 20), material);
  mesh.name = name;
  mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), delta.normalize());
  mesh.castShadow = true;
  mesh.receiveShadow = true;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function conePart(parent, name, position, radius, height, direction, material) {
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(radius, height, 20), material);
  mesh.name = name;
  mesh.position.set(...position);
  mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
    new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
    new THREE.Vector3(...direction).normalize()
  );
  mesh.castShadow = true;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const character = new THREE.Group();
character.name = 'character-laughing-nailong';
scene.add(character);

const tail = new THREE.Group();
tail.name = 'tail';
character.add(tail);

const tailCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
  new THREE.Vector3(0.45, 1.20, -0.62),
  new THREE.Vector3(1.05, 0.95, -1.00),
  new THREE.Vector3(1.72, 0.58, -0.72),
  new THREE.Vector3(2.00, 0.48, -0.05),
  new THREE.Vector3(1.83, 0.65, 0.48),
  new THREE.Vector3(1.55, 0.88, 0.62)
]);
const tailSegments = 48;
const tailRadial = 16;
const frames = tailCurve.computeFrenetFrames(tailSegments, false);
const tailPositions = [];
const tailIndices = [];

for (let i = 0; i <= tailSegments; i++) {
  const u = i / tailSegments;
  const p = tailCurve.getPointAt(u);
  const radius = 0.39 * Math.pow(1 - u, 0.82) + 0.012;
  for (let j = 0; j <= tailRadial; j++) {
    const angle = j / tailRadial * Math.PI * 2;
    const normal = frames.normals[i].clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(angle))
      .add(frames.binormals[i].clone().multiplyScalar(Math.sin(angle)));
    const v = p.clone().addScaledVector(normal, radius);
    tailPositions.push(v.x, v.y, v.z);
  }
}
for (let i = 0; i < tailSegments; i++) {
  for (let j = 0; j < tailRadial; j++) {
    const a = i * (tailRadial + 1) + j;
    const b = a + tailRadial + 1;
    tailIndices.push(a, b, a + 1, b, b + 1, a + 1);
  }
}
const tailTipIndex = tailPositions.length / 3;
const tailTip = tailCurve.getPointAt(1);
tailPositions.push(tailTip.x, tailTip.y, tailTip.z);
for (let j = 0; j < tailRadial; j++) {
  tailIndices.push(tailTipIndex, tailSegments * (tailRadial + 1) + j, tailSegments * (tailRadial + 1) + j + 1);
}
const tailGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
tailGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(tailPositions, 3));
tailGeo.setIndex(tailIndices);
tailGeo.computeVertexNormals();
const tailMesh = new THREE.Mesh(tailGeo, yellow);
tailMesh.name = 'curled-tapered-tail';
tailMesh.castShadow = true;
tailMesh.receiveShadow = true;
tail.add(tailMesh);

const body = new THREE.Group();
body.name = 'body';
character.add(body);
ellipsoid(body, 'round-torso', [0, 1.55, 0], [1.16, 1.36, 0.88], yellow);
ellipsoid(body, 'cream-belly', [0, 1.43, 0.76], [0.83, 1.02, 0.22], bellyMat);
ellipsoid(body, 'neck', [0, 2.55, -0.03], [0.82, 0.63, 0.70], yellow);

conePart(body, 'upper-back-spike', [0, 2.35, -0.78], 0.19, 0.43, [0, 0.35, -1], spineMat);
conePart(body, 'middle-back-spike', [0, 1.79, -0.88], 0.18, 0.40, [0, 0.15, -1], spineMat);
conePart(body, 'lower-back-spike', [0, 1.23, -0.79], 0.15, 0.34, [0, 0.05, -1], spineMat);

const legs = new THREE.Group();
legs.name = 'legs-and-feet';
character.add(legs);
ellipsoid(legs, 'left-haunch', [-0.76, 0.72, 0.02], [0.66, 0.66, 0.67], yellow);
ellipsoid(legs, 'right-haunch', [0.76, 0.72, 0.02], [0.66, 0.66, 0.67], yellow);

const leftFoot = new THREE.Group();
leftFoot.name = 'left-foot';
legs.add(leftFoot);
ellipsoid(leftFoot, 'left-foot-volume', [-0.78, 0.29, 0.52], [0.64, 0.30, 0.76], lightYellow);
const rightFoot = new THREE.Group();
rightFoot.name = 'right-foot';
legs.add(rightFoot);
ellipsoid(rightFoot, 'right-foot-volume', [0.78, 0.29, 0.52], [0.64, 0.30, 0.76], lightYellow);

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const foot = side < 0 ? leftFoot : rightFoot;
  for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
    ellipsoid(
      foot,
      (side < 0 ? 'left' : 'right') + '-toe-' + (i + 2),
      [side * 0.78 + i * 0.20, 0.34, 1.16 - Math.abs(i) * 0.05],
      [0.115, 0.09, 0.13],
      bellyMat
    );
  }
}

const arms = new THREE.Group();
arms.name = 'arms';
character.add(arms);

const leftArm = new THREE.Group();
leftArm.name = 'left-arm';
arms.add(leftArm);
capsuleBetween(leftArm, 'left-upper-arm', [-0.94, 2.16, 0.05], [-1.29, 1.60, 0.48], 0.25, yellow);
capsuleBetween(leftArm, 'left-forearm', [-1.29, 1.60, 0.48], [-0.67, 1.46, 0.96], 0.23, yellow);

const rightArm = new THREE.Group();
rightArm.name = 'right-arm';
arms.add(rightArm);
capsuleBetween(rightArm, 'right-upper-arm', [0.94, 2.16, 0.05], [1.29, 1.60, 0.48], 0.25, yellow);
capsuleBetween(rightArm, 'right-forearm', [1.29, 1.60, 0.48], [0.67, 1.46, 0.96], 0.23, yellow);

const hands = new THREE.Group();
hands.name = 'hands-holding-belly';
arms.add(hands);
ellipsoid(hands, 'left-hand', [-0.57, 1.47, 1.00], [0.39, 0.28, 0.24], lightYellow);
ellipsoid(hands, 'right-hand', [0.57, 1.47, 1.00], [0.39, 0.28, 0.24], lightYellow);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    ellipsoid(
      hands,
      (side < 0 ? 'left' : 'right') + '-finger-' + i,
      [side * (0.42 + i * 0.105), 1.40 - i * 0.025, 1.19],
      [0.075, 0.10, 0.07],
      lightYellow
    );
  }
}

const head = new THREE.Group();
head.name = 'head-tilted-back-laughing';
head.position.set(0, 3.37, 0.03);
head.rotation.x = -0.13;
character.add(head);

ellipsoid(head, 'large-round-head', [0, 0, 0], [1.50, 1.25, 1.12], yellow);
ellipsoid(head, 'left-head-nub', [-0.57, 1.00, -0.08], [0.24, 0.29, 0.23], lightYellow);
ellipsoid(head, 'right-head-nub', [0.57, 1.00, -0.08], [0.24, 0.29, 0.23], lightYellow);
conePart(head, 'little-crown-spike', [0, 1.20, -0.18], 0.15, 0.31, [0, 1, -0.12], spineMat);
ellipsoid(head, 'left-ear', [-1.37, 0.22, -0.12], [0.23, 0.31, 0.20], yellow);
ellipsoid(head, 'right-ear', [1.37, 0.22, -0.12], [0.23, 0.31, 0.20], yellow);

const eyes = new THREE.Group();
eyes.name = 'eyes-closed-with-laughter';
head.add(eyes);

function laughingEye(name, x) {
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  group.name = name;
  group.position.set(x, 0.50, 1.005);
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
    new THREE.Vector3(-0.28, -0.025, 0),
    new THREE.Vector3(-0.15, 0.085, 0.018),
    new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.125, 0.025),
    new THREE.Vector3(0.15, 0.085, 0.018),
    new THREE.Vector3(0.28, -0.025, 0)
  ]);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 28, 0.038, 10, false), darkMat);
  mesh.castShadow = true;
  group.add(mesh);
  eyes.add(group);
}
laughingEye('left-happy-eye', -0.62);
laughingEye('right-happy-eye', 0.62);

ellipsoid(head, 'left-nostril', [-0.17, 0.17, 1.105], [0.047, 0.032, 0.026], darkMat);
ellipsoid(head, 'right-nostril', [0.17, 0.17, 1.105], [0.047, 0.032, 0.026], darkMat);
ellipsoid(head, 'left-laughing-cheek', [-1.05, -0.10, 0.79], [0.25, 0.13, 0.055], cheekMat);
ellipsoid(head, 'right-laughing-cheek', [1.05, -0.10, 0.79], [0.25, 0.13, 0.055], cheekMat);

const mouth = new THREE.Group();
mouth.name = 'mouth-wide-open-laughing';
mouth.position.set(0, -0.39, 0);
head.add(mouth);

ellipsoid(mouth, 'dark-mouth-cavity', [0, 0, 1.045], [0.96, 0.70, 0.15], mouthMat);
const lip = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.72, 0.068, 14, 64), lightYellow);
lip.name = 'rounded-yellow-mouth-rim';
lip.position.set(0, 0, 1.13);
lip.scale.set(1.30, 0.94, 1);
lip.castShadow = true;
mouth.add(lip);

ellipsoid(mouth, 'tongue', [0, -0.40, 1.185], [0.59, 0.245, 0.075], tongueMat);
ellipsoid(mouth, 'tongue-highlight', [0, -0.33, 1.245], [0.34, 0.08, 0.025], new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xff9ba2,
  roughness: 0.8
}));

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const tooth = new THREE.Mesh(new RoundedBoxGeometry(0.29, 0.27, 0.11, 3, 0.045), toothMat);
  tooth.name = side < 0 ? 'left-upper-tooth' : 'right-upper-tooth';
  tooth.position.set(side * 0.25, 0.40, 1.19);
  tooth.rotation.z = side * -0.07;
  tooth.castShadow = true;
  mouth.add(tooth);
}

const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(200, 200),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffedc9, roughness: 1 })
);
ground.name = 'ground';
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
ground.position.y = -0.025;
ground.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(ground);

function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref: camera },
  characters: [character],
  render,
  ready: true
};

render(0);
</script>
